metadata.description: PreQ-BMC paper evidence matrix using the repaired sound derived-preimage methodology and matched verification ablations

cohort_definition.iris: The first ten correctly classified samples from the deterministic repository test split.
cohort_definition.mnist: Five fixed correctly classified test samples spanning low, median, previously verified, and high clean margins: 1607, 2228, 3, 9389, and 7753.

research_questions.RQ1: Full-test Python fixed-point versus generated-C differential evaluation and replay of available ESBMC counterexamples.
research_questions.RQ2: Certified fraction over fixed input-region cohorts; source-inconclusive and resource-limited outcomes remain in the denominator.
research_questions.RQ3: Derived-contract monolithic versus neuron-block verification with matched samples, formats, and resource limits.
research_questions.RQ4: Direct deployed-network E2E verification with and without sound intermediate invariants.
research_questions.RQ5: Per-layer formats, parameter-size reduction, float and quantized accuracy, mismatch, and saturation diagnostics.

notes: Only final_status=VERIFIED with guarantee_level=deployed-transfer is counted as certification.
Derived runs use DeepPoly source screening, MILP preimages, exact-prefix ESBMC validation of relational cuts, shared per-layer Q/I/F, enforced chaining, and no E2E fallback.
Block size zero is the monolithic hidden-layer baseline. Positive block sizes alter verification decomposition only and never select block-specific formats.
The E2E modes prove the deployed network directly and therefore do not use neuron blocks; their block size is explicitly zero.
The block-size sweep uses MNIST 1blk_25 in derived layer mode because a 10-neuron layer cannot meaningfully distinguish block sizes 10 and 20.
MNIST epsilon is in raw pixel units. eps=0.25 corresponds to approximately 0.000980392 in the normalized [0,1] domain.
Iris and Seeds epsilon values are expressed in their preprocessed approximately [0,1] domains.
compare_limit=0 evaluates deployment accuracy and Python/C agreement over the complete test split.
The requested 100000-point random plus PGD-style region probe is not implemented by the current JSON runner; full-test differential evaluation must not be described as that probe.
The current verification pipeline selects regions from its deterministic test split. This configuration does not claim that MNIST samples came from a separate validation split.
Outcome repetitions are intentionally excluded from this aggregate root because repetitions must not be counted as additional certified regions.
TIMEOUT, MEMOUT, UNKNOWN, SOURCE_PROPERTY_INCONCLUSIVE, PREIMAGE_UNAVAILABLE, and LAYER_INCONCLUSIVE are measured outcomes, not evidence that robustness is false.
Use --only to run one tier or mode at a time; all outputs use a new root and do not overwrite previous experiments.
